messages:
Lena (Product): quick sync — we need alignment on cross-team dependencies for the QuantRouting workstream. goal is staged GA for Q4 with cost-per-token target and p99 SLA.
Raj - Eng: the main open questions: who owns per-tenant model selection policy (quantized vs fp16), and what is the rollback surface if a quantized variant regresses quality?
Aiko (Runtime): runtime will surface per-request model_variant header and maintain KV caches per quant level, but we need infra to guarantee node-affinity during warm-up. otherwise caches get torn down and p99 spikes.
Dmitri (Infra): node-affinity is doable if we reserve warm-pool slots. need expected stickiness numbers and warmup token counts to size the pool. also need a playbook for evicting cold tenants.
Priya (Security): two compliance items: (1) model provenance metadata must be signed and verifiable for regulated customers; (2) key rotation in KMS must not invalidate live caches. that implies a migration path documented in the runbook.
Raj - Eng: for rollback surface, product wants an automated fallback: if quality regression > 3% on evaluation set or error budget burn > 10% in 24h, traffic should route to fp16 variant. runtime infra need a signal path for that.
Aiko (Runtime): we can emit a health flag and a traffic-steer API. propose this contract:
```json
{
  "tenant_id": "string",
  "model_variant": "string",
  "steer_action": "route|drain|force_variant",
  "reason_code": "string"
}
```
Lena (Product): product prefers automated steer to minimize customer impact. set thresholds: eval-quality-drop >= 3% OR p99 increase >= 200ms triggers automated partial rollback.
Dmitri (Infra): will add a new autoscale policy for warm-pools. example config we plan to support:
```
warm_pool:
  min_slots: 10
  max_slots: 100
  warmup_tokens: 5000
  keep_alive_secs: 300
```
this needs to be parameterizable per-tenant.
Priya (Security): also require immutability proof for model artifact before we move variant to production. we'll need a small signing service and a documented verification step in deploy pipeline.
ci-bot: deploy 1.3.0-quantroute passed with bench artifacts (sha: ef12ab34) :white_check_mark:
Raj - Eng: I'll attach the initial evaluation harness and a small report in a minute (metrics: BLEU-like sim, hallucination regression test, p99 latency).
Aiko (Runtime): risk note: quantized variants can have different memory patterns; we may need per-variant KV cache sizing and eviction heuristics. recommends a canary ramp: 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100% over 72h windows with monitoring hooks.
Lena (Product): agreed on canary cadence. gating to move to next stage: (a) no more than 1.5x background error rate, (b) latency p99 within target, (c) signed model artifact.
Dmitri (Infra): action: I'll craft two capacity plans: "reserving warm-pool" and "elastic spin-up" with cost delta estimates. deliver by Tue EOD.
Priya (Security): action: I'll spin up model-signing PoC and add KMS rotation notes; ETA Fri.
Aiko (Runtime): action: runtime will implement the steer health flag and per-variant cache tuning; PR by Thu.
Raj - Eng: action: engineering to produce regression/eval harness and initial pass on the quality threshold tests; ETA Mon.
Lena (Product): product will draft acceptance criteria and customer communication template (private beta messaging + rollback expectations) by Wed. include explicit cost target: < $0.45 per 1k generated tokens for anchor customers.
Raj - Eng: quick question — do we want per-tenant unit cost floor or a blended target?
Lena (Product): blended for public pricing, per-tenant SLAs for enterprise. we'll surface exceptions in contracts.
Aiko (Runtime): another operational note: telemetry labels must include model_variant and quant_level so cost attribution works. please make sure SDK/ingest teams tag spans.
Dmitri (Infra): noted; will add to infra ingest contract.
Priya (Security): one more: EU-only customers require model artifacts hosted in EU region. add that to the onboarding checklist.
Lena (Product): good catch. will include that in acceptance criteria.
Raj - Eng: I'll post the bench CSV and evaluation summary to this thread once uploaded.
Lena (Product): wrap-up: canary ramp plan + autoscale config + model-signing PoC + acceptance criteria doc. owners and dates above. we'll reconvene next Tue 10am if progress is on-track. thanks all. :rocket:
